requirements.statement: calendar_store/next_event_match shall implement dual-bank 128×23-bit sparse event lists with S0 registered SRAM read, S1 slot==counter qualification in noc_clk; entries sorted by slot; activation only at slot 0 after old-epoch retirement.
acceptance_criteria: BFM active-bank read fires at entry.slot with loaded inactive-bank contents after handoff.
No active-bank write occurs during replay.
Storage is exactly 5,888 payload bits per router (2×128×23).
Loader rejects lists exceeding 128 entries per bank.

requirements.statement: BG/escape shall use SharedPool-BG vc_buffers (shared pool 40 + per-port reserve 2) with RC→SA→ST pipeline and soft-priority service on non-matching cycles. Calendar never enqueues into the pool. Conservative hard bound 328 cycles; soft reserve-covered ~160; soft+pool contention ~200. H/V credits 16/20.
acceptance_criteria: BG never grants over a firing calendar event.
Calendar path never enqueues payload into vc_buffers.
When shared pool is exhausted, each port still accepts up to reserve=2 flits.

requirements.statement: multicast_fork shall be atomic on out_port_mask; watchdog_demote shall release once and emit lossless XY escape packets for remaining leaves into pool/reserves within 2 cycles of available capacity.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one reservation release per violation.
No drop of preserved flit/context under backpressure when capacity exists.

requirements.statement: μArch shall not instantiate combine_unit or DCA. Reduce/allreduce use Tier-A PE handoff; CAL_OP_PE_HANDOFF is forward/tag only.
acceptance_criteria: Router context and BFM builds contain no combine_unit.

requirements.statement: Analytic PPA for the μArch shall report relative area ≤0.92× (Arch-A4 default 0.822×) and power 0.92× vs IQ-XY, below Trial 3's 1.000×/0.95×, with buffers 0.182 and control 0.193.
acceptance_criteria: ppa-analytic.md and ppa_analytic_model.py report Arch-A4 area ≤0.92.
combine component is 0.000; calendar component is 0.009; buffers in [0.15,0.22].
Documented area delta vs Trial 3 is negative.

requirements.statement: Single noc_clk domain at 2 GHz; one 512-bit flit per granted direction per cycle; H=7 V=9 ramp=1 modeled as link/PE latency, not a second clock. Global slot counter wraps at 1024.
acceptance_criteria: BFM/mesh timing uses H=7 V=9 ramp=1.
No CDC synchronizer is required in the μArch.
